limits: Original independent Help ADVERSE is not rewritten as passed; later owner permanent regressions/full suite and native copies are separate evidence.
Readback checks exact archive/commit/working bytes and recorded outputs, not all product security or every manual repair claim.
Catalogue VM runs only pure embedded content/resolver in a DOM/network-free context; it does not execute browser/application code.
Full suite is 4 identity plus 1646 unit tests (1650 total), not 1650 unit tests.
Four copied programmes total 36 explicit cases, four separate copies and twelve post-run binary hashes; no hidden shell/packaged programmes are included.
